verdict.rationale: Check documents agent access to payroll data through its MCP server (payroll details, natural-language report generation) and a CLI for querying payroll data as JSON. It also mentions a QuickBooks Online integration via Components. None of this is a documented payroll journal export or an automated ledger reconciliation flow. missing for 10: explicit payroll journal/general-ledger report or export endpoint, documented agent-driven reconciliation into a ledger, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull payroll journal data via API or export and reconcile the entries into my ledger
